subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new typed agent/model-level total generation timeout config, or keep timeout control at provider/run/idle/first-event surfaces?
rationale: The request is a compatibility-sensitive public config contract, and current docs already expose provider-level timeout control, so automation cannot choose the permanent precedence and UX policy safely.

options.title: Add typed per-model generation timeout
options.body: Define a canonical agents.defaults.models timeout field, document precedence, and test fallback behavior for mixed fast, slow, thinking, and local models.

options.title: Keep provider/run timeout model
options.body: Leave users on models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds plus agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds and retitle or close this as docs/support once that policy is explicit.

options.title: Defer behind narrower reliability fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while landing targeted fixes such as the Gemini thinking watchdog and repetition-loop safeguards without committing to a new config surface yet.

recommendation.title: Add typed per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Define a canonical agents.defaults.models timeout field, document precedence, and test fallback behavior for mixed fast, slow, thinking, and local models.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history-backed combination of adjacent timeout-policy commits and direct product review on this issue.
